name: 仰躺雙手抱熊
prompt: An adult person lies on the back on a flat padded surface, hugging one soft teddy bear against the chest with both forearms. The head, shoulders and hips rest on the surface; both knees are bent with the feet supported. Both hands remain visible on the sides of the bear.

name: 坐地伸腿娃娃靠肩
prompt: An adult person sits on the floor with both legs extended straight forward and the hips fully supported, holding one plush toy against a shoulder. One palm supports its base while the other stabilizes its back; incline the torso slightly toward the toy.

name: 仰躺雙手舉娃娃
prompt: An adult person lies on the back with both shoulders and hips resting on a padded surface, knees bent and feet supported. Hold one plush toy above the upper torso with both hands, elbows softly bent, keeping the toy clear of the head.

name: 抱娃娃側坐
prompt: An adult person sits slightly sideways on a seat, holding one plush toy on the lap with both forearms around it. Keep both feet supported on the ground and the seated weight resting on the seat.

name: 坐著翻書
prompt: An adult person sits with one open book resting across the lap. One hand supports the lower edge while the other lifts a single page to turn it; the head is angled toward the pages and both feet are grounded.

name: 坐著看書
prompt: An adult person sits upright with one open book held above the lap, one hand supporting each lower corner. The head angles downward toward the pages, with the elbows close to the body and both feet supported.

name: 盤腿坐地捧書
prompt: An adult person sits cross-legged on a flat surface with both hips supported, holding one closed book against the lap with both hands around its lower corners. Angle the torso gently forward and keep the knees lowered to the sides.

name: 蹲下腋下夾書
prompt: An adult person crouches low with both knees deeply bent, hips lowered near the heels and feet firmly grounded. Hold one closed book between an upper arm and the torso, supporting its lower edge with that hand while the free hand rests on the nearer knee.

name: 跪坐小口吃蘋果
prompt: An adult person kneels with the hips resting on the heels and both shins supported, holding one apple in one hand and taking a small bite from its upper edge. Incline the torso slightly forward; the free hand rests on the thigh.

name: 單膝跪地遞蘋果
prompt: An adult person kneels on one knee with the opposite foot planted forward and that knee bent. Incline the torso forward and offer one whole apple in an open palm, keeping the elbow softly bent and the free hand resting on the forward thigh.

name: 跪坐吃香蕉
prompt: An adult person kneels with the hips resting on the heels, both knees bent and both shins fully supported. Hold one partially peeled banana upright in one hand and take a small bite from the exposed end. The attached peel hangs below the holding hand; the free hand rests on the thigh.

name: 坐地屈膝剝香蕉
prompt: An adult person sits on the floor with both hips supported, one leg extended forward and the other knee bent beside it. One hand holds the lower part of a single banana above the lap while the other pulls one strip of peel downward; keep the fruit and attached peel intact.

name: 蹲下單手比耶
prompt: An adult person crouches low with both knees deeply bent, hips lowered close to the heels and both feet firmly grounded. Raise one hand beside the shoulder with the index and middle fingers forming a V; fold the remaining fingers and rest the free hand on the knee.

name: 側坐雙手比耶
prompt: An adult person sits on the floor with both hips supported and both bent legs folded to one side. Raise both hands beside the head, each index and middle finger forming a V while the remaining fingers are folded; keep the elbows bent below shoulder level.

name: 盤腿坐著雙手比愛心
prompt: An adult person sits cross-legged on a flat padded surface, hips fully supported and knees lowered to the sides. Join both hands in front of the upper torso, with the thumbs forming the lower point and the curved index fingers forming the top of one heart; keep the elbows lowered.

name: 側躺單手比愛心
prompt: An adult person lies on one side with the hips and lower forearm supported on a flat surface, both knees softly bent and the legs stacked. Raise the free hand near the shoulder, crossing its thumb and index finger into a small finger heart while the remaining fingers fold naturally.

name: 跪坐前傾貓爪手勢
prompt: An adult person kneels with the hips resting on the heels and both shins supported, inclining the torso slightly forward. Bend both elbows and loosely curl both hands in front of the upper torso, palms angled downward in a small paw-like gesture, with gently bent wrists.

name: 坐地屈膝比兔耳
prompt: An adult person sits on a flat surface with both hips supported, knees bent and feet resting in front of the body. Raise both hands just above the head, extending each index and middle finger upward like rabbit ears while the other fingers fold; keep a clear gap between the hands.

name: 半蹲前傾雙手背後
prompt: An adult person crouches into a clear half-squat with both knees bent, hips lowered and the torso inclined forward from the hips. Loosely clasp both hands behind the lower back while keeping both feet firmly grounded and the neck aligned with the forward-tilted torso.

name: 蹲下抬手招呼
prompt: An adult person crouches low with the hips near the heels, knees deeply bent and both feet supported. Raise one hand to shoulder height with an open palm for a small wave while the free hand rests on the knee; keep the torso angled forward to balance the low pose.

name: 側坐 S 曲線
prompt: An adult person sits on one hip with both bent legs folded to the side and the hips fully supported. Angle the pelvis slightly opposite the shoulders to form a gentle S-shaped body line, resting one hand on the waist and the other beside the thigh.

name: 跪坐回眸扶腰
prompt: An adult person kneels with the hips on the heels and the back turned three-quarters away, both shins supported. Turn the head over one shoulder, rest one hand on the waist and the other on the thigh, keeping the hips low and the shoulders gently rotated.

name: 單膝跪地束髮扭腰

name: 仰躺雙手束髮
prompt: An adult person lies on the back with the shoulders and hips supported, one knee bent with its foot on the surface and the other leg extended. Gather the hair behind the head with both hands, opening the elbows to the sides while keeping the head supported.

name: 低弓步雙手扶腰

name: 蹲下扶牆側身拱背

name: 坐地伸腿高舉雙臂
prompt: An adult person sits on the floor with both hips supported and both legs extended forward. Raise both arms overhead, lightly holding the opposite wrist with one hand, and lengthen the torso with a gentle back curve while keeping the hips and legs on the surface.

prompt: An adult person sits sideways on a broad, low, sturdy top rail, with both hips clearly supported by the rail and both knees bent toward the walkway. Rest one hand on the rail beside the hip and the other on the waist, turning the shoulders slightly away from the hips.

name: 側坐交疊腿
prompt: An adult person sits slightly sideways on a seat with one knee crossed over the other and the lower foot resting on the ground. One hand rests on the upper knee and the other on the seat beside the hip; keep the torso gently lengthened.

name: 椅邊扶膝前傾

name: 側坐扭腰扶椅

name: 側跪收腿

Lean gently toward the rail with relaxed shoulders, keeping the hips at normal standing height and both legs extended below the pelvis.

name: 蹲下托花低頭聞花
